authority_policy.parties: Party identity is a single U-SEAS-owned master; consumers store opaque references and legally necessary immutable snapshots only.
authority_policy.network: NetworkMembership and CustomerRelationship are many-to-many, effective-dated and issued per-network/scope; no transitive CRM visibility.
authority_policy.authorization: Server-verified IAM grants + selected network/scope + entitlement + domain policy + lawful consent; client fields and role labels cannot authenticate.
authority_policy.metadata: Versioned G.Metadata schemas and scoped overlays, platform minimums enforced; no custom field may override canonical identity/KYC/accounting.
authority_policy.finances: DCB issuer-owned FinancialAccount/GL/Journal/Posting; cross-network access uses narrow revocable mandate and provider approval.
authority_policy.evidence: This adoption manifest does not prove a running integration; all native/SIT/auth-negative/UAT gates remain open.

context_contract.operator: principal_id and server-verified active tenant/network/scope workspace
context_contract.attributes: schema_key + schema_version + scoped value, no unrestricted raw PII
context_contract.authorization: IAM permission + scoped resource + data-sharing purpose + version + deny-by-default

observed_source_state: PulseX event participant/visitor may be a guest; authenticated brand/organizer/advertiser can link to U-SEAS PartyId.
scenarios: QR guest remains unlinked Target until approved identity resolution
brand organizer can participate in multiple Networks
offline event data does not bypass revocation/privacy on sync
